slice: ExecutionReceipt / EvidenceComparison / ProofReport v1 strict evidence output contracts (slice 2a, M1 evidence seam)
boundary: Verified against the exact changed bytes in evidence-output-source-manifest.json. This closes ONLY the receipt, comparison and report data contracts on the collect/read/compare/report paths plus their schema surface; it does NOT close parent point 2a, the BusinessRule reviewed/executed state machine, MT08 acceptance, the complete state/profile/concurrency matrix, or any point 3 register row.

Receipts remain NOT_PROVEN process observations. The receipt is revalidated against the separately stored operation, grant nonce, runtime image and payload hashes on every collect and stored-observation read; it never certifies itself and grants nothing.

No legacy receipt lane exists: no released store contains protected observations, and accepting an unmarked receipt would let a tamperer strip the version marker and downgrade validation. Unmarked or renamed markers are refused (explicit tamper test).

Comparisons remain NOT_PROVEN in both public lanes. Approved differences, execution_performed true, stronger verdicts, unknown fields, wrong phase receipts and self-certified grades are refused before any public return or render.

The rendered report now emits the derived ProofReport as its machine-readable body; rule coverage stays unverified, claims stay empty, execution_performed stays false. No installation/configuration, model egress, real-project execution or public write occurred. Point 4 remains HOLD.

design.receipt: ExecutionReceipt v1: exact field set, version/kind marker, observed grade, NOT_PROVEN verdict, digest-pinned image, strict booleans/ints, input-transport consistency, and caller-supplied bindings (job/attempt/profile/phase/source/oracle/environment/image/nonce/input hashes/bytes). require_collected additionally demands a completed, untimed-out, untruncated, cleaned-up, source-unchanged collection with complete input. The executor self-checks the shape before checkpointing; capture and stored observation reads revalidate with the full operation bindings.
design.comparison: EvidenceComparison v1: two named lanes discriminated by their declared grade markers. The observed lane requires its protected observation references (both phases), case rows matching the compared count, exact case fields and non-empty unobserved effects; the reported lane validates its inner per-case comparison and count. Both refuse stronger verdicts, execution, approved differences, unknown or partial fields.
design.report: ProofReport v1: derived only from a validated comparison, binds comparison_sha256, carries provenance (protected observed pair vs reported evidence), NOT_PROVEN, empty claims, unverified rule coverage, the comparison's missing evidence and unobserved effects, execution_performed false.
design.schema_surface: execution-receipt-v1, evidence-comparison-v1 and proof-report-v1 descriptors are served data-only through Engine, native CLI (--name choices), registered tool and registered slash, matching schemas/*.json by digest and granting/executing nothing.
